Access - IAM - objects - policies: JSON documents that explicitly allow or deny actions on specific resources.
Access - IAM - objects - roles: Temporary permission sets that users or AWS services can assume without long-term keys.
Access - IAM - objects - groups: Collections of users to make applying permissions easier.
Access - IAM - objects - users: Long-term identities for single people or programs.
Access - IAM - STS - definition: AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) is a web service that lets you request short-term, limited-privilege credentials for IAM users or federated users. It eliminates the need to embed long-term access keys into applications, granting safer, time-limited access that automatically expires
Access - IAM - STS - package - SecretAcc: Secret key used to sign requests
Access - IAM - STS - package - SessionTo: Additional security token required for all requests
